content: Fable 5.1 and Astra struggled to generate randomized, procedurally combined cloud patterns in SVG despite consuming two weeks of compute credits. While some models achieved acceptable visual quality, they lacked adequate control over randomness. Conversely, simpler patterns like peony or thunderbolt motifs were successfully generated by Gemini 3.6 Flash. The task reveals that visually simple cloud patterns require complex procedural generation to meet specific aesthetic standards.

title: 震撼，果蝇大脑成功接上了ChatGPT
content: A developer simulated a 138,000-neuron fruit fly brain on a MacBook, translating its neural discharge into natural language to interact with ChatGPT. The model, built using NumPy and public connectomics data, demonstrated verified reflexes: high-frequency signals for sugar intake and low-frequency for bitter rejection. While it successfully followed directional commands, it failed at foraging, highlighting a gap between command execution and strategic planning. This experiment underscores that complex neural simulations are now achievable on standard consumer hardware without specialized chips.

title: Anthropic 据悉选择在纳斯达克上市进行 IPO
content: Anthropic has selected Nasdaq as its target exchange for an upcoming initial public offering, with a planned listing in October 2026. The company had previously filed a confidential IPO application in mid-2026, signaling its intention to enter public markets shortly. This move positions Anthropic for what could be the largest IPO to date, as it advances its public listing strategy in direct competition with rival OpenAI, which has explicitly ruled out a 2026 listing.
